topBearNews.title: Job cuts are at a four-year low, according to Challenger data
topBearNews.summary: Job cuts are at a four-year low, according to Challenger Grey data illustrating the over 500,000 job cuts that have occurred in 2026 year-to-date. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley and BD8 Capital Partners, LLC CEO Barbara Doran to take a closer look and this data discuss whether AI-driven job loss fears were initially overblown. The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) is scheduled to release August jobs data on Friday, September 4.
